notes.title: You're now a Docent
notes.text: Impressionism: yes. Renaissance: not even a second glance. The curators of Renaissance would like a word. Painter 7 keeps getting your approval. It may be time to admit you have a favorite. When you love something, you say it's the light. We believe you. Give Renaissance one more honest look before you write it off for good.

notes.title: An honest assessment
notes.text: We now guess your reaction right 68% of the time. Don't let it go to your head. Or ours. Your latest Love was Portrait of a Lady 1070 by Painter 16. Bold choice. We respect it. Peru keeps winning. The tourism board thanks you. Give Post-Impressionism one more honest look before you write it off for good.

notes.title: Your taste so far
notes.text: You've kept or loved most of the Impressionism works you've seen. When you explain a Love, you most often point to light and color. You respond often to art from Peru. Consider giving Post-Impressionism another look; you may find one that changes your mind.
